[R1]1.3 Retrieval-Augmented Generation（RAG）Source: 5584-LLM-for-Agent-2.md · Lecture 7 Agent Memory and RAG / Part 1 RAG 的研究动机与基本原理 / 1.3 Retrieval-Augmented Generation（RAG）1. LLM 无法将全部知识，尤其是长尾知识（Long-tail Knowledge），完整编码进参数。2. 训练结束后新增的信息与专业领域知识，也不一定能够被模型准确获取。重新训练或微调（Re-training / Fine-tuning）可以改变模型能力，但通常需要较高的计算与数据成本，并不适合所有知识更新需求。Retrieval-Augmented Generation（RAG）通过将外部检索结果引入生成过程，使模型能够利用参数之外的信息完成任务。其基本过程为：常见的输入级 RAG 可形式化为：案例：询问 2023 年女足世界杯冠军。未使用 RAG 的旧模型可能由于知识截止时间而无法回答；使用 RAG 后，模型通过外部信息获得事实，回答 Spain。传统 LLM 与 RA-LLM =可以类比为：闭卷考试与开卷考试Close-book Exam：仅依赖模型参数中已有的知识。Open-book Exam：允许检索外部参考资料，再生成答案。其关系可以概括为：Retrieved for context; not used as evidence.[R2]1.5 RAG 的两个关键步骤Source: 5583-Agentic-Computing-2.md · Lecture 6: Retrieval-Augmented Generation RAG / Part 1 Why RAG? / 1.5 RAG 的两个关键步骤Two Critical Steps in RAG1. Generation：Reasoning over that information and responding.生成：基于这些信息进行推理并作答。第一类问题：不需要专门收集外部信息，模型可直接依据已有知识回答。第二类问题：需要先调查特定事件，再综合证据生成回答。Retrieval 主要解决：应该把哪些信息交给模型？Generation 主要解决：已经拿到这些信息，应该如何回答？这是 RAG 系统最重要的职责划分。Retrieved for context; not used as evidence.[R3]3.2.2 Self-RAG 的核心机制: Reflection TokensSource: 5583-Agentic-Computing-2.md · Lecture 7 Retrieval Optimization and Agentic RAG Systems 检索优化与智能体 RAG / Part 3 Advanced RAG Architectures…传统 RAG 通常使用固定的两阶段流程：Self-RAG（Self-Reflective Retrieval-Augmented Generation）引入可学习的反思 Token（Learned Reflection Tokens），使模型能够在检索和生成过程中进行自主判断。三个判断：Reflection Token · 核心问题 · 判断阶段 · 作用Retrieve? · Is retrieval needed? · 检索之前 · 判断是否需要外部知识
Relevant? · Are documents relevant? · 检索之后 · 判断检索证据是否相关

Generation Grounding：生成内容是否有依据。与固定检索流程相比，Self-RAG 的关键变化是将检索与证据评估纳入模型学习的决策过程。Retrieved for context; not used as evidence.[R4]1.8 RAG DefinitionSource: 5583-Agentic-Computing-2.md · Lecture 6: Retrieval-Augmented Generation RAG / Part 1 Why RAG? / 1.8 RAG DefinitionRAG combines a pretrained LLM with external knowledge retrieved at inference time to support generation.RAG 将预训练语言模型与推理时检索到的外部知识结合起来，以支持答案生成。RAG 的关键特征是在推理阶段检索外部知识，并利用检索结果支持生成，而不是要求模型事先记住全部知识。Pretrained LLM：预训练语言模型表示系统已经拥有一个经过训练的模型。它可以具备：语言理解能力、通用知识、文本生成能力、一定的推理能力。RAG 通常不需要从头训练一个新的语言模型。External knowledge：外部知识课件明确列举: Local documents, knowledge base, web search, APIs ... 即本地文档、知识库、网页搜索和 API 等。这些来源有一个共同点：信息不必全部编码在语言模型参数中。Retrieved at inference time：推理时检索Inference time 指模型实际处理用户请求、生成回答的阶段。在典型 RAG 中，系统会根据当前问题，从外部来源寻找相关信息。这与训练阶段学习知识不同。Cited in the answer.[R5]4.6 全讲要点Source: 5583-Agentic-Computing-2.md · Lecture 6: Retrieval-Augmented Generation RAG / Part 4 Retrieval Evaluation 检索评估 / 4.6 全讲要点1. Knowledge beyond trainingRAG can provide private, recent or specialized information.RAG 可以补充模型训练之外的私有、近期或专业信息。2. Retrieval before generationRelevant documents ground the answer in supplied evidence.先检索相关文档，再基于检索证据生成回答。3. Retrieval methodsKeywords match terms, embeddings match meaning, and filters enforce criteria.关键词匹配词项，Embedding 匹配语义，Metadata Filter 执行条件约束。4. Evaluation guidanceRetrieved for context; not used as evidence.[R6]2.2 Building the Augmented Prompt 构造增强提示Source: 5583-Agentic-Computing-2.md · Lecture 6: Retrieval-Augmented Generation RAG / Part 2 RAG Architecture / 2.2 Building the Augmented Prom…RAG 的增强不是直接改变模型参数，而是在生成前把检索证据组织进模型输入。Why were Hong Kong hotels expensive last weekend? 为什么香港酒店上周末那么贵？1. 从 Relevant Documents 到 Augmented PromptPrompt → Retriever → Relevant Documents → Augmented Prompt这意味着检索结果不能只停留在检索器中。它们必须以某种方式提供给生成模型。通常做法是把原始问题、检索片段和任务指令组织成新的 Prompt。其中：：Augmented Prompt。：Instructions，任务指令。：检索得到的上下文。：原始问题。Retrieved for context; not used as evidence.[R7]2.4 Advantages of RAG RAG 的五项优势Source: 5583-Agentic-Computing-2.md · Lecture 6: Retrieval-Augmented Generation RAG / Part 2 RAG Architecture / 2.4 Advantages of RAG RAG 的五项优势3. Supports source citation：支持来源引用RAG 可以保留文档的来源信息，例如：文件名称、URL、文档 ID、页码、片段位置。回答时可以展示引用，帮助用户核查。但要区分：能够引用来源与引用正确支持答案。前者是系统功能，后者需要额外验证。4. Separates retrieval from generation：检索与生成分离这是重要的工程优势。当回答错误时，可以分别检查：Retriever 是否找到了正确证据？Generator 是否正确使用了证据？例如，检索结果正确但回答错误，问题可能出在生成阶段。反过来，如果检索器根本没有找到关键文档，单纯修改生成提示可能无法解决根本问题。这种模块化设计使系统更容易测试、替换和优化。5. Helps alleviate hallucinations：缓解幻觉检索证据能够降低模型在缺少信息时随意补充事实的风险。但它不能彻底消除幻觉。因为模型仍可能：误读证据。Retrieved for context; not used as evidence.
tests.answerText:
RAG combines a pretrained language model with external knowledge retrieved at inference time to support answer generation. [R4]

The retriever searches the external source for the current question instead of relying on knowledge stored in the model parameters. [R4]
The retrieved passages are grounded context for generation rather than the final answer, and the model itself is usually not retrained. [R4]
The external source can be local documents, a knowledge base, web search or an API. [R4]
RAG supplies knowledge at inference time while fine-tuning changes the model parameters, so updating knowledge means updating the index rather than retraining. [R4]

tests.answerText:
A MapReduce job runs in three stages, mapping, shuffling and reducing, keeping communication small and treating every record independently. [R4]

Mapping: each node applies its mapper to the data it has already loaded locally. [R4]
Shuffling: nodes exchange the intermediate data produced by the mappers. [R4]
Reducing: reducers merge the results of the different mappers, produce the final output and store it locally. [R4]

tests.answerText:
Agent memory is grouped by content into episodic, semantic and procedural memory. [R4]

Episodic memory stores the specific events an agent has lived through, that is, its experiences and interaction records. [R4]
Semantic memory stores stable knowledge abstracted from experience, such as facts, concepts and generalisations, rather than single events. [R4]
Procedural memory stores skills and executable operations, which the course illustrates with systems such as Voyager. [R4]
The classification is by content rather than by storage, so all three kinds can sit in a text database or a vector database. [R4]

tests.answerText:
Tool use for an agent is a layered system: capabilities, mechanics, constraints, interfaces and systems. [R1]

Mechanics covers how tool definitions enter the model context, how the model emits a call, and how the harness executes it and returns the result. [R1]
Constraints covers JSON Schema and grammar masks, which constrain the form of an output but cannot guarantee that its meaning is right. [R1]
Interfaces covers how REST APIs and MCP expose external capabilities to the agent. [R1]

The term convolution refers to the mathematical combination of two functions to produce a third function. It merges two sets of information. 卷积是两个函数的数学组合，产生第三个函数；它把两组信息合并。2. 操作定义：Convolution is essentially sliding a filter over the input. 卷积本质上就是把一个滤波器/卷积核在输入上滑动。3. 直觉定义：A convolution can be thought as looking at a function's surroundings to make better/accurate predictions of its outcome. 卷积可以理解为看一个函数的周围环境，以便对它的结果做出更准的预测。这就意味着，卷积的输出在某个位置上的值，取决于输入在该位置邻域内的取值，而不是该位置单独的取值。Cited in the answer.[R3]2.1 CNN DefinitionSource: 5205-Introduction-to-AI.md · Lecture 5 / Part 2 CNN I 卷积神经网络（卷积层与池化层） / 2.1 CNN DefinitionConvolutional Neural Networks learn a complex representation of visual data using vast amounts of data. They are inspired by the human visual system and learn multiple layers of transformations, which are applied to the top of each other to extract a progressively more sophisticated representation of the input.CNN 用大量数据学习视觉数据的复杂表示；它受人类视觉系统（局部感受野 + 逐级抽象）启发，学习多层变换（每一层都在对上一层的输出做运算），这些变换逐层叠加（至少一个非线性函数），从而提取出越来越精细的输入表示Retrieved for context; not used as evidence.[R4]5.5 图神经网络 What is a Graph Neural Network?Source: 5205-Introduction-to-AI.md · Lecture 5 / Part 5 GNNs I: From Graphs to GNNs / 5.5 图神经网络 What is a Graph Neural Network?Define:A GNN is an optimizable transformation on all attributes of the graph nodes, edges, global-context, connectivity that preserves graph symmetries.GNN 是作用在图的全部属性（节点、边、全局上下文、连接关系）上的可优化变换，并且保持图的对称性。Main Idea:Pass messages between nodes to refine node and possibly edge representation.在节点之间传递消息，以此来精修节点（可能还有边）的表示。1. 节点V、边E、全局上下文U、连接关系这四个属性全都要处理。2. 可优化变换：GNN 不是一套固定规则，不是人为设定，它的参数是通过训练学的（与 CNN、MLP 同源）。3. 保持图的对称性：节点换编号后结果不能变，这就是要保持的对称性。4. 传递消息：这是 GNN 的工作方式，也是消息传递网络（Message Passing）每个节点从邻居那里收消息，更新自己的表示，然后进入下一层。Retrieved for context; not used as evidence.[R5]6.4 GNN vs CNNSource: 5205-Introduction-to-AI.md · Lecture 5 / Part 6 GNNs II: Graph Convolution / 6.4 GNN vs CNN对比维度 · CNN（Part 2–3） · GNN / GCN（Part 5–6）数据形态 · 规则网格（图像） · 不规则的图

tests.answerText:
MCP standardises the interface between AI applications and external tools, turning an N times M integration problem into N to 1 to M. [R1]

Without MCP each of N applications adapts to each of M tools separately, so integration cost grows as a product. [R1]
With one protocol a tool is integrated once, and a real deployment can still run several MCP servers. [R1]
The host runs the model loop and the user interface and can own several clients. [R3]
A client translates the intent of the host into MCP messages; it is not the model, which handles reasoning and tool selection. [R3]
